apps.subtitle: An experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13+.
apps.localizedDescription:
Modification of Reynard browser allowing JIT during runtime with Lockdown mode enabled. Reynard is a Gecko-based mobile web browser for iOS 13+.

Unlike other browsers on iOS that are forced to use Apple's WebKit engine (including Safari and all third-party browsers), Reynard uses Gecko. This is the same engine that powers the Firefox browser on desktop and Android devices.

This is mainly for users on older iOS versions who are stuck with an outdated version of WebKit. Because WebKit is bundled with the OS, these devices cannot receive engine updates and often fail to load modern websites. By using Gecko which is kept up to date independently, Reynard allows these sites to work again. Users on newer iOS versions can also use the browser if they want an alternative browser engine on their device.

Source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets websites in this browser scan QR codes, capture photos, and start video calls.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access lets websites in this browser capture your voice for calls and audio recordings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Photo library access lets this browser save images and other media you download from websites to Photos.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access lets this browser upload photos and videos from your library and save images and other media you download from websites to Photos.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access lets websites in this browser provide location-based content such as maps, directions, and nearby places.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.1...0.18.0

### New Features
- When a webpage uses a keyboard shortcut that conflicts with one of the app's, the first press now goes to the webpage, and a hint appears in the address bar letting you press the shortcut again to trigger the app's.

### Improvements
- Scrolling on webpages is now smoother and more accurate.
- Improved audio handling, with better echo cancellation, voice processing, recovery after interruptions, and handling of audio device changes.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where keyboard shortcuts would not be recognized by websites after using Find in Page or a <select> element.
- Fixed an issue where the image preview and its actions would not work on certain images, such as those requiring authentication or in the WebP format.
- Fixed an issue where tapping the status bar to scroll to the top would not scroll completely to the top of the webpage when using the top address bar.
- Fixed an issue where touches on some webpages would land in the wrong place.
- Added small performance improvements and fixed several UI issues.

### Engine

Updated Gecko to [158.0](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_158_0_RELEASE) (released Oct 13, 2026).

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.0...0.17.1

This is a minor release that fixes issues found in 0.17.0. For the complete list of changes, see the [0.17.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.17.0).

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Text selections outside input fields now offer more actions, such as Look Up, Find Selection, Translate, and Share.
- Fixed a crash when editing in scrollable text fields on iOS 14 and older.
- Fixed an issue where touching the selection handles to drag them would clear the selection in text fields on some webpages.
- Fixed an issue where the caret and text selection would not stay aligned with sticky text while scrolling.
- Fixed an issue where tapping a focused text field or caret would not bring up the edit menu on iOS 17 and later.
- Fixed an issue where images copied from another app would not paste into webpages.
